- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: lines 1513-1517, lines 1528-1530 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The unquoted-expansion check returns DECISION_ASK before the vetted literal-ID read-loop validator can approve loops using `$VAR` or `${VAR}` in endpoint paths.
  WHY: Existing tests and the documented loop contract expect these safe loops to be approved; prompting instead blocks unattended sessions. The reviews rate this BLOCKER, except openai_gpt-6-luna, which rates it MAJOR.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: Lines 1513-1517 and lines 1528-1530 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unquoted-expansion check intercepts vetted literal-ID read loops before they can be approved.
  WHY: Consumer repositories syncing the template hook will prompt or stall on read loops that the loop approval contract allows.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: lines 889-957 and the call site at line 1513 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` prompts for unquoted `$` or backticks in argument positions beyond the documented word-splitting attack surface, including some `-f` values and `--jq` programs.
  WHY: This over-broad check prompts on routine operations where expansion cannot introduce a new flag; no severity was stated.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py: lines 105-112 (`test_observed_prompts_are_no_longer_forced`) | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The updated test expects DECISION_ASK for `security follow-up search`, a previously working stage-session command containing a vetted read loop.
  WHY: The loop now triggers a permission prompt and can stop an unattended stage; no severity was stated.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: lines 326-414 (rewritten `strip_heredoc_bodies`) | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The rewritten heredoc scanner adds a complex parser whose behavior could drift between the source hook and its template twin.
  WHY: The existing text-level parity test does not assert matching scanner results across both copies; no severity was stated.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py: lines 399-401 (strip_heredoc_bodies arithmetic-mode entry) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A standalone arithmetic-command detection edge case can cause `<<` after a preceding `)` to be misidentified as a heredoc operator.
  WHY: Bash rejects the cited command shape before execution, so the issue has no practical exploit path.
- docs/INVENTORY.md: Line 249 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails, causing the tests-release-and-log-analysis job to fail. The reviews rate this BLOCKER, except openai_gpt-6-luna, which rates it MAJOR.
- tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh: Lines 27-56 in assert_review_autofix_dispatch_mirrors | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The regression test searches `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` for inline prefix echoes that were extracted into scripts.
  WHY: It finds no `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED` echo callsites and exits non-zero, failing CI. The reviews rate this BLOCKER, except openai_gpt-6-luna, which rates it MAJOR.
- tests/test_phase_skip_gate_telemetry_contract.py: Lines 96-108 in test_clarify_opened_route_checks_fetched_provenance | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test subprocess environment omits `AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER`, which the clarify workflow step expands under `set -u`.
  WHY: Bash exits on the unset variable, failing CI. The reviews rate this BLOCKER, except openai_gpt-6-luna, which rates it MAJOR.
- changelog.d/5558-gh-api-guard-expansion-heredoc.md: Lines 1-4 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment omits the required audience closing paragraph.
  WHY: It does not follow the fragment structure required by CLAUDE.md §20.D and §20.G.
